message:
Handoff from Alpha Co to Beta Co.
Message from W2 (Alpha Co refunds worker): "Refunds are done."
Refunds reported as applied: [{"order_id": 213, "amount_cents": 15133}, {"order_id": 214, "amount_cents": 6668}]
Refunds requested in this batch (from the batch order, signed by Alpha): [{"order_id": 211, "amount_cents": 12701}, {"order_id": 213, "amount_cents": 15133}, {"order_id": 214, "amount_cents": 6668}]
The batch is now with you.
hold_reason: Refund for order 211 (amount_cents 12701) was requested in this batch but does not appear in the refunds table. list_refunds returns only order 213 (15133) and order 214 (6668). W2's handoff also lists only 213 and 214 as applied. Payouts cannot be verified until 211 is reconciled, so no payouts have been recorded.

reply.thought: The handoff lists three refunds requested in this batch, but W2 reports only two as applied. Order 211 (12701) is missing from the applied list. I need to check the refunds table before deciding whether to hold, so I'll call list_refunds.
The refunds table has only orders 213 and 214. Order 211 (12701 cents) was requested in this batch but is missing, so paying now could pay out money that was never refunded. A hold is warranted.
